001package org.clafer.scope;
002
003import java.math.BigDecimal;
004import java.util.HashMap;
005import java.util.Map;
006import org.clafer.ast.AstClafer;
007
008/**
009 * Builder pattern for scopes. Use {@link Scope#builder()},
010 * {@link Scope#setScope(org.clafer.ast.AstClafer, int)}, {@link Scope#defaultScope(int)},
011 * {@link Scope#intLow(int)}, {@link Scope#intHigh(int)}, {@link Scope#mulLow(int)},
012 * {@link Scope#mulHigh(int)}, {@link Scope#stringLength(int)}, {@link Scope#charLow(char)},
013 * or {@link Scope#charHigh(char)} to construct the builder. Will provide
014 * defaults for the parameters that are not explicitly specified.
015 *
016 * @author jimmy
017 * @see Scope
018 */
019public class ScopeBuilder implements Scopable {
020
021    private final Map<AstClafer, Integer> scope;
022    private int defaultScope = 1;
023    private int intLow = -16;
024    private int intHigh = 16;
025    private Integer mulLow = null;
026    private Integer mulHigh = null;
027    private int stringLength = 10;
028    private char charLow = 0x20;
029    private char charHigh = 0x7e;
030    private int decimalScale = 0;
031    private BigDecimal decimalLow = null;
032    private BigDecimal decimalHigh = null;
033
034    ScopeBuilder(Map<AstClafer, Integer> scope, int defaultScope, int intLow, int intHigh,
035            Integer mulLow, Integer mulHigh, int stringLength, char charLow, char charHigh,
036            int decimalScale, BigDecimal decimalLow, BigDecimal decimalHigh) {
037        this.scope = new HashMap<>(scope);
038        this.defaultScope = defaultScope;
039        this.intLow = intLow;
040        this.intHigh = intHigh;
041        this.mulLow = mulLow;
042        this.mulHigh = mulHigh;
043        this.stringLength = stringLength;
044        this.charLow = charLow;
045        this.charHigh = charHigh;
046        this.decimalScale = decimalScale;
047        this.decimalLow = decimalLow;
048        this.decimalHigh = decimalHigh;
049    }
050
051    ScopeBuilder() {
052        this.scope = new HashMap<>();
053    }
054
055    /**
056     * Set the scope of the Clafer. If the scope is already set for the Clafer,
057     * then the new scope overrides the previous one.
058     *
059     * @param clafer the Clafer
060     * @param scope the scope of the clafer
061     * @return this builder
062     */
063    public ScopeBuilder setScope(AstClafer clafer, int scope) {
064        this.scope.put(clafer, scope);
065        return this;
066    }
067
068    /**
069     * Adjust the scope of the Clafer. If the Clafer already has a scope then
070     * {@code newScope = oldScope + adjust}. Otherwise
071     * {@code newScope = defaultScope + adjust}.
072     *
073     * @param clafer the Clafer
074     * @param adjust increment the scope by this amount
075     * @return this builder
076     */
077    public ScopeBuilder adjustScope(AstClafer clafer, int adjust) {
078        Integer oldScope = scope.get(clafer);
079        scope.put(clafer, adjust + (oldScope == null ? defaultScope : oldScope));
080        return this;
081    }
082
083    /**
084     * Set the scope for unspecified Clafers. If the default scope is already
085     * set, then the new default scope overrides the previous one.
086     *
087     * @param defaultScope the default scope
088     * @return this builder
089     */
090    public ScopeBuilder defaultScope(int defaultScope) {
091        this.defaultScope = defaultScope;
092        return this;
093    }
094
095    /**
096     * Adjust the scope of unspecified Clafers.
097     *
098     * @param adjust increment the default scope by this amount
099     * @return this builder
100     */
101    public ScopeBuilder adjustDefaultScope(int adjust) {
102        return defaultScope(defaultScope + adjust);
103    }
104
105    /**
106     * Set the lowest (inclusive) integer used for solving. If the lowest
107     * integer is already set, then the new lowest integer overrides the
108     * previous one.
109     *
110     * @param intLow the lowest integer
111     * @return this builder
112     */
113    public ScopeBuilder intLow(int intLow) {
114        this.intLow = intLow;
115        return this;
116    }
117
118    /**
119     * Adjust the lowest integer used for solving.
120     *
121     * @param adjust increment the lowest integer by this amount
122     * @return this builder
123     */
124    public ScopeBuilder adjustIntLow(int adjust) {
125        return intLow(intLow + adjust);
126    }
127
128    /**
129     * Set the highest (inclusive) integer used for solving. If the highest
130     * integer is already set, then the new highest integer overrides the
131     * previous one.
132     *
133     * @param intHigh the highest integer
134     * @return this builder
135     */
136    public ScopeBuilder intHigh(int intHigh) {
137        this.intHigh = intHigh;
138        return this;
139    }
140
141    /**
142     * Adjust the highest integer used for solving.
143     *
144     * @param adjust increment the highest integer by this amount
145     * @return this builder
146     */
147    public ScopeBuilder adjustIntHigh(int adjust) {
148        return intHigh(intHigh + adjust);
149    }
150
151    /**
152     * Set the lowest (inclusive) integer used for solving multiplication. If
153     * the lowest integer is already set, then the new lowest integer overrides
154     * the previous one.
155     *
156     * @param mulLow the lowest integer
157     * @return this builder
158     */
159    public ScopeBuilder mulLow(int mulLow) {
160        this.mulLow = mulLow;
161        return this;
162    }
163
164    /**
165     * Set the highest (inclusive) integer used for solving multiplication. If
166     * the highest integer is already set, then the new highest integer
167     * overrides the previous one.
168     *
169     * @param mulHigh the highest integer
170     * @return this builder
171     */
172    public ScopeBuilder mulHigh(int mulHigh) {
173        this.mulHigh = mulHigh;
174        return this;
175    }
176
177    /**
178     * Set the longest (inclusive) string used for solving. If the longest
179     * string is already set, then the new longest string overrides thy previous
180     * one.
181     *
182     * @param stringLength the longest string
183     * @return this builder
184     */
185    public ScopeBuilder stringLength(int stringLength) {
186        this.stringLength = stringLength;
187        return this;
188    }
189
190    /**
191     * Adjust the longest string used for solving.
192     *
193     * @param adjust increment the longest string by this amount
194     * @return this builder
195     */
196    public ScopeBuilder adjustStringLength(int adjust) {
197        stringLength += adjust;
198        return this;
199    }
200
201    /**
202     * Set the lowest (inclusive) character used for solving. If the lowest
203     * character is already set, then the new lowest character overrides the
204     * previous one.
205     *
206     * @param charLow the lowest character
207     * @return this builder
208     */
209    public ScopeBuilder charLow(char charLow) {
210        this.charLow = charLow;
211        return this;
212    }
213
214    /**
215     * Adjust the lowest character used for solving.
216     *
217     * @param adjust increment the lowest character by this amount
218     * @return this builder
219     */
220    public ScopeBuilder adjustCharLow(int adjust) {
221        charLow += adjust;
222        return this;
223    }
224
225    /**
226     * Set the highest (inclusive) character used for solving. If the highest
227     * character is already set, then the new highest character overrides the
228     * previous one.
229     *
230     * @param charHigh the highest character
231     * @return this builder
232     */
233    public ScopeBuilder charHigh(char charHigh) {
234        this.charHigh = charHigh;
235        return this;
236    }
237
238    /**
239     * Adjust the highest character used for solving.
240     *
241     * @param adjust increment the highest character by this amount
242     * @return this builder
243     */
244    public ScopeBuilder adjustCharHigh(int adjust) {
245        charHigh += adjust;
246        return this;
247    }
248
249    /**
250     * Set the number of fractional digits of decimals.
251     *
252     * @param decimalScale the decimal scale
253     * @return this builder
254     */
255    public ScopeBuilder decimalScale(int decimalScale) {
256        this.decimalScale = decimalScale;
257        return this;
258    }
259
260    /**
261     * Set the lowest (inclusive) decimal used for solving. Without it, the
262     * lowest decimal that fits Choco's integers at the decimal scale.
263     *
264     * @param decimalLow the lowest decimal
265     * @return this builder
266     */
267    public ScopeBuilder decimalLow(BigDecimal decimalLow) {
268        this.decimalLow = decimalLow;
269        return this;
270    }
271
272    /**
273     * Set the highest (inclusive) decimal used for solving. Without it, the
274     * highest decimal that fits Choco's integers at the decimal scale.
275     *
276     * @param decimalHigh the highest decimal
277     * @return this builder
278     */
279    public ScopeBuilder decimalHigh(BigDecimal decimalHigh) {
280        this.decimalHigh = decimalHigh;
281        return this;
282    }
283
284    /**
285     * Finalizes all the decisions made in the builder. Further changes to this
286     * builder is permitted for building more scopes, but the returned scope
287     * will not be affected.
288     *
289     * @return the built scope
290     */
291    @Override
292    public Scope toScope() {
293        return new Scope(scope, defaultScope, intLow, intHigh,
294                mulLow, mulHigh, stringLength, charLow, charHigh,
295                decimalScale, decimalLow, decimalHigh);
296    }
297}
